newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan c. bank auction drains 935 mln dirhams.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan c. bank auction drains 935 mln dirhams.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) drained 935 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its weekly repurchase auction, a bank spokeswoman said on Thursday.
The bank received bids totalling 2.95 billion dirhams and allocated 865 million dirhams at 6.5 percent interst rate. It was less than the 1.8 billion dirhams leaving the market this week.
The next auction will be held on August 4, she said.
